title: "Metric-affine-like" generalization of YM (mal-YM): detailed classical consideration
summary: We consider the ``metric-affine-like'' generalization of the Yang-Mills theory (mal-YM) which we first proposed earlier. In this model, the connection is no longer assumed to be compatible with the Hermitian form in the fibers. As a consequence, along with the usual YM potential $\boldsymbol{A}_a$ and the field strength tensor $\boldsymbol{F}_{ab}$, it contains non-trivially interacting fields $\boldsymbol{B}_a$, $\boldsymbol{h}$, and $\boldsymbol{G}_{ab}$, $\boldsymbol{N}_a$, forming a non-Abelian generalization of Stückelberg theory.
